name: blueprint
description: Turn a rough idea into PRD, SPEC, and TASKS docs an AI coding agent can build from, or document an existing project the same way.

interface.shortDescription: Write PRD, SPEC, and TASKS before vibe coding
interface.longDescription: Use Blueprint to turn a rough idea into documents an AI coding agent can build from without guessing: a PRD (why and what), a SPEC (how), and TASKS (ordered, verifiable steps). It interviews in plain language, one question at a time, so non-developers can use it, and reviews each document against a checklist. Pointed at an existing project, it writes the same documents for what was built, with links into the code and tasks for what to fix.
defaultPrompt: Use Blueprint to turn my app idea into PRD, SPEC, and TASKS docs.
Use Blueprint to plan this model before we write any code.
Use Blueprint to document this existing project so I can understand and improve it.
